literal_meaning: লোকের ধর্ম (people's religion or folk duty)
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে লোকধর্ম না মানলে সমাজে থাকা কঠিন হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: In the village, it's hard to survive without following folk customs.
Even after moving to the city, he hasn't forgotten the moral ideals of his people.
note: Refers to unwritten social codes in Bengali society
